notes: Glass looks like glass in photoreal renders: wine glasses, vases and bottles (photoreal materials) bend the light, with real glass's highlights and edges; windows are clear, even seen at a slant (the render pack updates itself). Edit Material's photoreal settings are now Glossiness, Reflectivity and Metal. Every slider has a box to type its value. The Render window shows the current view before you render. Choosing Paint opens the Materials panel.
